_comment: v0.16 F1 (#308) the BETRAYAL branch, which had zero live QA coverage before this script: draw steel on Rags, win, and prove the exclusion holds in all three places. The branch banks drove_off_rags AND rags_meeting_settled from one on_victory array -- which is exactly why the F1 offer's hide_when and the camp mouth's present_when.absent both have to name drove_off_rags, and why proving BOTH banks is the point. Every absent-assert here is payload-filtered or a count: assert_event_absent is a WHOLE-RUN scan with no cursor, so a bare-type absent on dialogue_started / combat_started / accomplishment_recorded / map_changed would find this run's own event and red.

steps._comment: One step south lands on the shipped approach cell (16,20), facing the watcher at (16,21).

payload_contains.speaker: Rags
payload_contains.text: You. The one who didn't kill.

steps._comment: First-contact VISIBLE list: 1 'Who are you?', 2 '(Say nothing. Wait.)', 3 '(Draw steel.)', 4 '(Leave them to their business.)'. The F1 offer is progress-gated on rags_meeting_settled and does not render at all here.
EVENT-ORDER TRAP: the option's effects run and `end: true` closes the graph BEFORE start_combat, so dialogue_ended precedes combat_started.
BOTH terminals bank off one on_victory array -- the whole reason the offer's gate has to be two-armed.

== PROOF 1: NO OFFER == the encounter entity is removed permanently on victory, so a second interact on the same cell opens nothing. This CANNOT be an assert_event_absent on dialogue_started -- the run opened her graph itself three steps ago -- so the proof is the COUNT: one open in the whole run.
steps.name: interact

payload_contains.speaker: Rags
payload_contains.text: Good trade. Plains quiet. Go safe.

steps._comment: Payload-filtered: chieftains_price DOES start on this run (the draw-steel option carries it), so only the F1 quest id can be proved absent.

== PROOF 2: THE CAMP STAYS SHUT == east one to (17,20), then south one to (17,21) facing (17,22). rags_camp_mouth's present_when.absent arm fails on drove_off_rags, so the prop is not there to block, not there to open, and not there to render.

payload_contains.text: You go down between the stones sideways, the way the flattened grass says to, and the plains close over the top of you.

steps._comment: == PROOF 3: THE QUEST NEVER RUNS == no route counter, no terminal.
